_comment: The ruleset-size subsets with the full ruleset drawn per seed. Every file below size 57 is the same file data/rules/subset_manifest/ pins; each seed's size-57 file holds the 57 rules in an order of its own. The files are not committed: they regenerate byte for byte from the generator, ruleset and seeds below, and manifest.sha256 pins all 1400.

reproducibility.rng: random.seed(seed), then random.sample for sizes 2..57 in order, from one stream
